meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein acne aur oily skin ke liye **700 rupees ke andar** kai behtareen serums available hain. Acne ke liye sabse best ingredient **Salicylic Acid (BHA)** ya **Niacinamide** maana jata hai, jo pores ko saaf karta hai aur active acne ko theek karta hai.

Aapke budget ke andar kuch top-rated options yeh hain:

### 1. Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Approx. Price:[insightcosmetics.in](https://insightcosmetics.in/products/2-salicylic-acid-active-acne-face-serum#:~:text=2%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Active%20Acne%20Face%20Serum.,an%20excellent%20choice%20for%20balancing%20oily%20skin.)** ₹549 (30ml)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-salicylic-acid/c/20703?sort=popularity&transaction_id=f089829cdcd2ea06e46b5910298720fb&eq=mobile#:~:text=Minimalist%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum%20For,Derma%20Co.%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum.)
* **Fayde:** Yeh active acne, blackheads, aur whiteheads ko target karne ke liye sabse popular serums mein se ek hai. Yeh skin ke andar jaakar excess oil aur pores ki गंदगी ko saaf karta hai.

### 2. The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Approx. Price:[insightcosmetics.in](https://insightcosmetics.in/products/2-salicylic-acid-active-acne-face-serum#:~:text=2%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Active%20Acne%20Face%20Serum.,an%20excellent%20choice%20for%20balancing%20oily%20skin.)** ₹483 - ₹549 (30ml)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/serums-with-salicylic-acid/c/20703?sort=popularity&transaction_id=f089829cdcd2ea06e46b5910298720fb&eq=mobile#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co.%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face,%26%20Willow%20Bark%20For%20Active%20Acne%20Day%2BNight.)
* **Fayde:[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=%E2%82%B9206%20%E2%82%B9299%2031%25%20off.%204.2%20%284291%29%2015,15%20gm%2015%20gm%20x%202%20%7C)** Isme Salicylic Acid ke sath Witch Hazel aur Willow Bark extract hota hai, jo acne ki redness aur inflammation ko kam karne mein madad karta hai.

### 3. Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Skin Clearing Face Serum

* **Approx. Price:[insightcosmetics.in](https://insightcosmetics.in/products/2-salicylic-acid-active-acne-face-serum#:~:text=2%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Active%20Acne%20Face%20Serum.,an%20excellent%20choice%20for%20balancing%20oily%20skin.)** ₹399 - ₹440 (30ml ke alag packs available hain)
* **Fayde:[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/serum-essence-salicylic-acid-serum-and-essence#:~:text=%E2%82%B9206%20%E2%82%B9299%2031%25%20off.%204.2%20%284291%29%2015,15%20gm%2015%20gm%20x%202%20%7C)** Agar aapki skin sensitive hai aur acne ke sath irritation bhi hoti hai, toh yeh Cica (Centella Asiatica) aur Salicylic acid wala serum best hai kyunki yeh skin ko calm rakhta hai.

### 4. Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Clarifying Serum

* **Approx. Price:[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/serum/top-10-best-faceserums/#:~:text=Foxtale%2012%25%20Niacinamide%20Clarifying%20Serum%20*%20Contains,control%2C%20pore%20minimisation%2C%20and%20acne%20mark%20fading.)** ₹452 - ₹645[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/acne-serum#:~:text=No%20Parabens%2C%20No%20Silicones%2C%20No%20Sulphates%2C%20No,%26%20Whiteheads%20%7C%20Targets%20Active%20Acne%20%7C)
* **Fayde:[www.purplle.com](https://www.purplle.com/collections/acne-serum#:~:text=No%20Parabens%2C%20No%20Silicones%2C%20No%20Sulphates%2C%20No,%26%20Whiteheads%20%7C%20Targets%20Active%20Acne%20%7C)** Agar aapko active pimples se zyada **acne marks (daag-dhabbe)** aur oily skin ki problem hai, toh Niacinamide ek acha option hai. Yeh oil control karta hai aur skin texture ko improve karta hai.

---

### Kuch Zaroori Baatein:

* **Patch Test:** Koi bhi naya serum use karne se pehle apne haath ya kaan ke piche patch test zaroor kar lein.
* **Sunscreen:[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/collections/face-serum#:~:text=As%20the%20best%20face%20serum%20for%20glowing,effectively%20with%20this%202%25%20salicylic%20acid%20serum.)** Agar aap Salicylic acid serum use kar rahe hain, toh din mein sunscreen lagana bilkul na bhulein.
